blocks.text: Cloud computing aisa model hai jis mein servers, storage aur applications jaise computing resources (wasail) internet par aasani se mil jate hain. Yeh resources bohat jaldi diye aur wapas liye ja sakte hain, aur is mein na zyada intezam (management) karna parta hai na service provider se baar baar rabta. Cloud computing aise hai jaise aap ke paas ek taqatwar computer ho jise aap internet ke zariye chalate hain. Apne mehnge computers aur storage devices khareedne aur sambhalne ki bajaye aap cloud services se data rakhte, applications chalate aur apni computing ki zaroorat poori karte hain. Is se kaam aasan aur sasta ho jata hai: jitni service chahiye utni lein, aur sirf utne ki qeemat dein jitna istemal kiya. Yeh aise hai jaise supercomputer kiraye par le liya ho jo duniya mein kahin se bhi, jab chahein, istemal ho sake.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Bijli ki misal lein: har ghar apna power plant nahi lagata, balke bijli company se leta hai aur meter ke hisaab se bill deta hai. Cloud mein bhi computer ki taqat aur storage provider se li jati hai aur istemal ke hisaab se paisa diya jata hai (pay as you go).

blocks.prompt: Apne servers khareedne ke muqable mein cloud computing ke do faide bataiye.
blocks.explanation: 1) Shuru mein mehnga hardware khareedne aur us ki dekh bhaal ki zaroorat nahi. 2) Jitni zaroorat ho utne resources lein aur sirf istemal ki qeemat dein; zaroorat barhe ya ghate to resources bhi barh ya ghat sakte hain.

items: Cloud computing: servers, storage aur applications internet par, zaroorat ke waqt.
Khareedne aur sambhalne ki bajaye kiraye par istemal; sirf istemal ki qeemat.
